newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Major says by-election loss makes no difference.
newsitem.headline: Major says by-election loss makes no difference.

text.p: British Prime Minister John Major said on Friday he did not think Labour's victory in the Barnsley East by-election would affect his ability to choose an election date.
Speaking to reporters as he left his hotel for a European summit meeting, he said: "I don't think it is going to make a material difference."
He added: "I think we will be able to hang on to our preferred date."
Major said the Barnsley result was no surprise and sent his congratulations to the victorious Labour candidate, Jeff Ennis.
He said he would not be drawn into speculation about the election date.
The deadline for the election is May 22, but Major has previously said it will not be held later than May 1.
